scope: Internal next-run brief, not drafted/published content or measured demand.
titleDirection: AIで社内FAQを作る｜質問をまとめる前の確認メモ
readerQuestion: 似た質問をまとめてよいか。対象者や時期で答えが変わる質問、元資料に答えがない質問をどう残すか。
artifactFields: 回答が同じになる条件
exampleRequirement: Clearly fictional internal rules and4–5questions; show merge, separate and hold examples. Missing source text is a question to resolve, not proof of prohibition.

scopeEvidence.supports: Existing scope includes documents/access/freshness and FAQ/previous-response organization; not a new service promise.

differentiation.rag-document-inventory-checklist: Owns source material inventory, not question-group editing.
differentiation.rag-answer-review-sheet: Owns generated answer review, not combining FAQ questions.
differentiation.ai-inquiry-classification-checklist: Owns inquiry routing/categories, not authoring conditional FAQ.

requirementsBeforePublication: Check current live first-party service content.
Review19existing articles again for intent overlap.
Use fictional examples only; no real customer questions, identities or confidential documents.
Consult vendor primary docs only if product-specific features/settings are introduced.

ready.work: AIで社内FAQを整える短い記入例とテンプレートを作る。
ready.implementation: Create one useful article only after checking live first-party service scope and all existing article intents. Latest-model subagent writes; root checks. Show explicit fictional source rules and4–5questions demonstrating merge/split/hold decisions, not only generic field descriptions. Existing renderer, no new UI/card/template redesign. Leave all frozen articles/service bodies unchanged; new page may link out to relevant existing service.
ready.measurement: Reader-intent hypothesis, not measured search demand. No promises of inquiry reduction, accuracy or ranking. Track as one page package with fresh baseline and Pacific full-day window; preserve all other starts.
ready.verification: Build/head/body/Article1/WebPage1/sitemap/list/internal navigation; one scoped production desktop/mobile check. No public references/internal meta.
